# ReShiki 0.12.0

This release adds chemical names, NMR prediction, generic structures, atom maps and new drawing tools, with atom labels that work more like ChemDraw and an experimental agent API.

- **Chemical names:** type a name in **Import → Name** to insert its structure, or right-click a molecule and choose **Show chemical name**. Names are converted on your computer.
- **NMR prediction:** predict ¹H and ¹³C shifts that link to the atoms of a molecule. The report floats beside the drawing or docks under **Predict**.
- **Generic structures and atom maps:** expand element lists, variable positions and repeating units, including polyesters and polyethers, into every concrete structure. Map atoms between reactants and products, with **Auto-map** to suggest a mapping.
- **3D:** fade the back of 3D cages with **Rear opacity**. MOL files keep their 3D coordinates when you open or export them.
- **Pen paths and attached arrows:** draw straight and curved segments as one path. Mechanism arrows follow the atoms, bonds and lone pairs they point at.
- **ChemDraw-like labels:** type `Pd2+` to set a charge of +2, format label characters with **Cmd/Ctrl+-** and **Cmd/Ctrl++**, and draw a bond from a text label.
- **Copy and paste:** **Cmd/Ctrl+C** now pastes as a vector picture in PowerPoint, Word and Keynote and as an editable structure in ChemDraw. It no longer adds SMILES text: for text fields such as SciFinder's, use **Cmd/Ctrl+Alt+C**. Paste prefers ReShiki and ChemDraw data, then structure text, then pictures.
- **Experimental agent API:** `reshiki --mcp` lets AI agents such as Claude Code and Codex draw, convert and analyze, and `reshiki --cli` does the same from a terminal. `reshiki --cli skill` writes an Agent Skill. Tools and results may change.

The installed application remains one executable and works without Python or RDKit. Chemical names and NMR prediction run on your computer.

**Drawing compatibility:** older drawings remain readable. Every file saved by 0.12 uses document format 26, even when it uses no new feature, and cannot open in 0.11.0 or earlier. Keep a copy saved by 0.11.0 if you share files with people who use it.

macOS downloads are signed and notarized. Windows and Linux downloads remain unsigned; Windows signing is pending. The optional Microsoft 365 add-in remains an MVP for sideloaded testing, and its real-host acceptance is pending.

[Complete changes and contributor credits](https://reshiki.com/developer/changes-0.12/) · [Chemical names](https://reshiki.com/guide/names/) · [Generic structures](https://reshiki.com/guide/generic-structures/) · [Connect AI agents](https://reshiki.com/guide/agents/).
